subject: Request: redistribute private-offer commit across projects / drawdown update
messages:
From: Kenji Ito <kito@haloanalytics.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@haloanalytics.com
Date: Fri, 01 Oct 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: private offer drawdown - request to reallocate commit

Connor — thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday. Two quick asks from my side as we finalize internal approvals: 1) We need to redistribute $250k of the private-offer commit from the Analytics Platform SKU to a new Exploratory Projects SKU (internal code: EXP-2027) that starts billing this month; 2) Can you smooth the drawdown so we don’t hit the high-burn threshold in early Nov when several pilot workloads spike?

Attached is an updated forecast (halo-usage-forecast-Q4-2027.csv). Procurement asked for a short note we can attach to our SOW describing the reallocation mechanics so procurement/legal can sign off. Any timeline on an amended private-offer term sheet?

—Kenji
Kenji Ito
Head of Cloud Procurement | Halo Analytics
kito@haloanalytics.com

[Attachment: halo-usage-forecast-Q4-2027.csv]

From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
To: Kenji Ito <kito@haloanalytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 01 Oct 2027 12:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: private offer drawdown - request to reallocate commit

Kenji — appreciate the clear ask and the forecast. Short answers up front: we can reassign committed dollars across SKUs within the same private offer, and we can apply a temporary smoothing schedule to reduce early-Nov burn. Work required: 1) update the private-offer term sheet (new amortization across SKUs), 2) GCP Marketplace needs a SKU remap file from us (gcp-sku-mapping-redwood.xlsx) and a short acceptance note from your procurement team, and 3) we should lock in the co-sell listing mapping so your sales team sees the correct SKUs in the marketplace UI.

I’m looping in Marissa for co-sell enablement and Ben for billing/invoice phasing. I’ll get a draft term sheet to you by COB Monday. Does that timing work?

—Connor
Connor O'Brien
Director, Partnerships | Redwood Inference
connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com

[Attachment: gcp-sku-mapping-redwood.xlsx]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>, Kenji Ito <kito@haloanalytics.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 01 Oct 2027 13:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: private offer drawdown - request to reallocate commit

Kenji — quick notes from co-sell: we need the new EXP-2027 SKU to appear on the marketplace product page with the same co-sell tags you currently use (partner-led, enterprise). If you can have a single procurement acceptance line saying “Halo Analytics accepts SKU mapping and adjusted amortization schedule” that will be enough for our marketplace team to move the mapping through. Connor — for go-live, recommend we: 1) set SKU mapping change to take effect 10/07 so billing aligns with your pilots; 2) create a short marketplace asset (one-pager) linking EXP-2027 to your existing listing so our GCP co-sell reps have collateral. Kenji, can your enablement contact give us a 1-pager by Monday?

—Marissa
VP, GTM Partnerships | Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Kenji Ito <procurement@haloanalytics.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 04 Oct 2027 08:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: private offer drawdown - request to reallocate commit

Hi all — billing notes: we can smooth the drawdown with a 60-day rolling buffer so the committed consumption is amortized monthly rather than front-loaded. Practical implications: Halo will see smaller monthly invoices in Oct/Nov and a slightly extended redemption runway into Jan. We’ll need a signed amendment to the term sheet to: a) accept the reallocation, and b) acknowledge the amortization change. I’ve attached a redline suggestion to the term sheet and the proposed amortization table.

Kenji — if procurement signs the short acceptance line Marissa mentioned and returns the signed doc, we can have accounting update invoices starting with the Oct 15 invoice.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Director, Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Halo_Private_Offer_TermSheet_v3.pdf]

From: procurement@haloanalytics.com <procurement@haloanalytics.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: kito@haloanalytics.com
Date: Mon, 04 Oct 2027 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: private offer drawdown - request to reallocate commit

Ben / Connor — Halo Procurement (on behalf of Halo Analytics) accepts the SKU mapping file and the adjusted amortization schedule. Please find the signed acceptance line below; we will follow up with a countersigned amendment if the DocuSign envelope includes the same wording.

Acceptance: "Halo Analytics accepts SKU mapping EXP-2027 and the adjusted monthly amortization schedule as provided by Redwood Inference on 2027-10-04."

Regards,
Halo Procurement
procurement@haloanalytics.com

[Signed: Halo Procurement]

From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
To: procurement@haloanalytics.com <procurement@haloanalytics.com>, Kenji Ito <kito@haloanalytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, GCP Marketplace Support <mp@gcpmarketplace.com>
Date: Mon, 04 Oct 2027 17:03:00 -0700
Subject: RE: private offer drawdown - request to reallocate commit

Thanks — appreciate the quick turnaround and the signed acceptance line. Next steps (ownership inline):
1) Ben — finalize the amendment and send DocuSign envelope (we’ll include the acceptance line). Target: sent today, sign by EOD Tue 10/05.
2) Marissa — we’ll push the SKU mapping to GCP on 10/07 and publish the one-pager to the partner asset folder; confirm when live.
3) Laura (ops) — trigger accounting change for Oct 15 invoice to use the new amortization table.
4) Halo — once the DocuSign envelope is back, confirm the pilot schedule and we’ll keep the 60-day rolling buffer active.

Kenji — attaching the updated term sheet and mapping for your records. Will follow up if GCP Marketplace support requests anything else.

—Connor
Connor O'Brien
Director, Partnerships | Redwood Inference
connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com

[Attachments: Halo_Private_Offer_TermSheet_v3.pdf, gcp-sku-mapping-redwood.xlsx]
